body:
Slice 1 of 6 of #508 (seam v — the S3 wire surface). No hard code dependency; scheduled after the #636 protocol slices it will project.

## What

A `MultipartGateway` companion trait in `crates/gateway-core`, mirroring `ContainerGateway` (ADR-0046 decision 6 / ADR-0010 keep `ObjectGateway` object-only, so a new concern arrives as a narrow companion trait), implemented by `crates/server` at the composition root and projected by the S3 crate alone. Every verb answers a typed NotImplemented. Routing untouched — the subresource denylist still answers 501 on the wire.

## Acceptance

- trait + composition-root implementation compile and are reachable from the S3 crate; wire behavior unchanged;
- `cargo xtask ci` green.

Part of #508 / epic #513.

milestone.title: 0.1 Alpha
milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.

title: s3: MultipartGateway companion trait + composition root (508.1)
